text:
maya: Heads-up: linkcheck is flagging a bunch of anchors after the site migration. Docusaurus and mkdocs slug rules diverge on fancy punctuation (smart quotes, ellipses, soft-hyphens).
leo: saw a few in the CI logs. example: heading `How to work with user` (copied from an old MD) ends up with different slug between pipelines.
alex: can you paste the failing lines?
maya: from linkcheck job:
```
[linkcheck] WARNING: ./tutorials/cli-usage.mdx: anchor not found: using-the-cli--examples
[linkcheck] WARNING: ./reference/auth.mdx: anchor not found: secure-keysoverview
```
leo: repro'd locally. Docusaurus slugify removes soft-hyphen (U+00AD) differently than mkdocs. Also U+2026 (…)gets mapped to nothing vs `...`.
alex: quick mitigation idea: run a small preprocessor pass in the docs pipeline to normalize headings. strip \u200B-\u200D, \uFEFF, \u00AD and map fancy ellipsis to three dots, turn curly quotes into straight ones. keep it conservative.
maya: small bash example to add to docs-ci before linkcheck:
```bash
# normalize headings in-place
for f in $(git ls-files '*.md' '*.mdx'); do
  perl -C -pe "s/[\x{200B}-\x{200D}\x{FEFF}\x{00AD}]//g; s/\x{2026}/.../g; s/[\x{2018}\x{2019}]/'/g; s/[\x{201C}\x{201D}]/\"/g;" -i "$f"
done
```
leo: also add test vector to docs-lint so future changes fail fast. a single mocha/jest test that slugifies a set of sample headings with both slugifiers and asserts equality.
alex: i'll draft a tiny node script that normalizes and prints diffs for review. then open a PR and mark it `docs:quick` for fast-track.
devops-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1482 by alex. CI queued (linkcheck, docs-lint).
maya: nice. after merge we should run a maintenance backfill that applies the sanitizer across main and opens a single commit-per-file PR if diffs exist, or one big commit if infra prefers. which is less noisy?
eng-infra: we'd prefer a single maintenance commit with a signed-off bot user for small whitespace/char fixes. we can run it as a maintenance workflow with a dry-run first.
leo: add a changelog note in the migration guide: "slug normalization to avoid fragmented anchors after migration" and list what chars are normalized. keeps customers aware.
alex: updated PR: added perl normalizer, node diff script, and a unit test. included a short note in docs/migration.md. pinging @maya @leo for review. :eyes:
maya: reviewing now. looks safe. can we also collapse double spaces that appear after removals?
alex: added collapse: `s/\s{2,}/ /g` in the perl one-liner. pushed.
devops-bot: CI passed for PR #1482 44d.
maya: merging now. please coordinate backfill.
eng-infra: scheduling maintenance job T+1h to run sanitizer across the tree as a non-destructive job (commits only if files change). will post status here.
leo: once backfill completes, run linkcheck across the deployed preview to validate anchor fixes.
eng-infra: backfill finished: 47 files modified, single maintenance commit `docs: normalize headings and fix fragmented anchors (backfill)` pushed by infra-bot. linkcheck now green on main.
maya: awesome. thanks all. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
